articles.title: Bitcoin trades near $77,700 as analysts eye $75,000 support after liquidation wave
articles.snippet: Open interest held steady and funding stayed subdued during the recent liquidation wave, suggesting traders were de-risking rather than capitulating, according to HashKey Research's Tim Sun.

articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: Crypto prediction markets are turning into dangerous national security risks, and Congress wants to ban them
articles.snippet: Bubblemaps investigators led by Nicolas Vaiman, discovered 80 bets on Polymarket with a 98% win rate that he said is statistically impossible to achieve.

articles.title: Accused attackers of Sandbox exec’s wife tried to flee via Uber
articles.snippet: CertiK reported earlier this month that criminal wrench attack teams usually consist of three to five people and are often made up of amateurs, while the masterminds are outside the country.

articles.title: Binance launches SpaceX-linked perpetual futures ahead of IPO
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange's new pre-IPO futures product lets traders speculate on SpaceX’s expected public market valuation before the company begins trading on public exchanges.
